sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

The applicant has filed this first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure,
1973 for grant of bail.

2. Applicant is in custody in connection with Crime No.343 of 2023 registered at Police Station Handia, District Harda for the offence punishable under sections 363, 366, 376 (3), 376 (2)(N) of IPC and under Sections 3/4 (2) read with section 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
3. Prosecution story, in short, is that the present applicant has committed offence upon the person of the minor prosecutrix on the false pretext of 2 MCRC-23578-2024 marriage.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in the case.
He is not concerned with the case directly or indirectly.
It is also submitted the the prosecutrix is a major woman.

It is further submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that specific Raju vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4142185/
1 allegation has not been levelled against the applicant.

entities.text: Raju vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is also submitted that in order to extort money from the applicant, prosecutrix has lodged false FIR against him.
There is no likelihood of his absconsion, if he is granted the benefit of bail.
He is ready to abide by all the terms and conditions as may be imposed by this Court.
With the aforesaid submissions, prayer for bail is made.
5. On the other hand, learned Public Prosecutor for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application.
On such grounds, he prayed for its rejection.

6. After hearing rival contentions and going through the impugned order, this Court finds that the prosecutrix is a major lady and investigation is already completed and challan has already been filed in the matter.
Therefore, this Court finds that there is no need for custodial interrogation of the present applicant in the matter.

7. Accordingly, without commenting on merits of the case, the instant application is allowed and it is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant be released on bail on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer (Investigating Officer).
8.
The applicant shall make himself available for interrogation by the Investigating Officer as and when required.

He shall further abide by the other conditions enumerated in sub-section (3) of Section 437 of Cr.P.C.
9.
